meta.title: K to °C — Convert Kelvin to Celsius | Turbo Unit Converter
meta.description: Convert Kelvin (K) to Celsius (°C) instantly. 1 K = -272.15 °C. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert kelvins (K) to celsiuss (°C) instantly. Both measure temperature, so the relationship is strictly linear: each kelvin equals -272.15 celsiuss. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One kelvin is equal to **-272.15 celsiuss**. To go the other way, one celsius equals **274.15 kelvins**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> celsiuss = kelvins × -272.15

Worked example — converting 10 kelvins:

10 × -272.15 = **-263.15 °C**.

To invert, divide by -272.15 (or multiply by 274.15).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 K ≈ -272.15 °C. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Kelvin and Celsius both measure temperature; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many celsiuss are in 1 kelvin?
**A:** -272.15 celsiuss.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert K to °C?
**A:** celsiuss = kelvins × -272.15.

**Q:** How do I convert °C back to K?
**A:** Multiply by 274.15 (or divide by -272.15).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this K to °C converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
